english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is allowed to do something or for making a polite request.
Use 可以 as the all-purpose choice for general ability, permission, and possibility.
Use 可以 when a rule, place, condition, or amount of time makes something allowed or possible rather than someone actively granting it.
Use 可以 for conditional ability or a gentle suggestion, rather than the request pattern 可唔可以 + V.
